policy_rows.selected: {"consequence":"Staff can use those preferences to spread pickups across the available windows.","decision":"How should readers and staff agree on pickup windows?","mechanism":"Readers rank pickup windows on the request sheet before staff reserve shelf space."}

{"consequence":"Preparation effort follows readers who are likely to collect soon.","decision":"Who should choose when a requested book is prepared?","mechanism":"Readers confirm they are on their way, and staff then prepare the requested books from the preparation list."}

{"consequence":"The desk receives grouped arrival updates without a continuous line of introductions.","decision":"How should a reader announce arrival?","mechanism":"A helper gathers names from arriving readers and carries the arrival sheet to the pickup desk at regular intervals."}

{"consequence":"Service follows the greater current wait instead of a fixed group order.","decision":"How should walk-ins share the pickup desk with booked readers?","mechanism":"Staff begin each service block with the longer waiting group, whether booked readers or walk-ins."}

{"consequence":"Common issues can be settled during the wait rather than at collection.","decision":"How should quick questions be separated from book collection?","mechanism":"The helper asks waiting readers for routine questions and writes answers on the pad before they reach the pickup desk."}

{"consequence":"The desk list directs the search without sorting the shelves by either field.","decision":"How should shelf labels help staff locate requested books?","mechanism":"Staff assign a shelf location to each requested book and put that location beside both reader name and pickup window on a desk list."}

{"consequence":"The reader chooses among the remaining spaces before the extra hold is arranged.","decision":"What should happen when a reader misses a pickup window?","mechanism":"Staff contact the reader with the remaining pickup windows and move the book only after the reader selects one."}

{"consequence":"The slips preserve order without requiring a separate intake conversation.","decision":"How should a returned book enter the checking queue?","mechanism":"Readers place returned books beside completed return slips, and helpers check them in arrival order."}

{"consequence":"Short batches balance prompt return with compact shelving trips.","decision":"How should checked returns be reshelved?","mechanism":"Helpers divide checked returns into small trolley batches and sort each batch by shelf location before shelving it."}

{"consequence":"Transfers follow immediate pickup demand.","decision":"How should a book move between the preparation area and the desk?","mechanism":"Desk staff send a transfer list for the readers currently waiting, and preparation helpers fill the tray to match it."}

{"consequence":"Readers can choose help after seeing what they need that day.","decision":"How should readers request extra assistance?","mechanism":"A helper offers assistance at arrival and records accepted requests on a list."}

{"consequence":"Shared and individual updates proceed without waiting for one another.","decision":"How should a reader hear about a temporary delay?","mechanism":"A helper keeps the delay notice current while staff speak with affected readers at the same time."}

{"consequence":"The pickup desk does not need to introduce the feedback request.","decision":"How should feedback be gathered without slowing departures?","mechanism":"A helper offers feedback cards near the exit and points readers to the collection box."}

{"consequence":"The handover starts from a prepared record.","decision":"How should helpers hand over unfinished tasks?","mechanism":"The outgoing helper writes the unfinished-task list before the overlap and explains it to the incoming helper."}

{"consequence":"Readers encounter the expectation as they choose where to wait.","decision":"How should the library encourage quieter waiting?","mechanism":"Staff place the quiet-waiting notice beside the waiting spots before the service starts."}

{"consequence":"The improvement begins with a measured bottleneck and checks its effect on readers.","decision":"How should staff choose one improvement for the next afternoon?","mechanism":"Staff identify the longest waits in the log and use reader feedback to choose one improvement during closing."}
